I can do that — a few quick clarifying questions before I reschedule:

1. Which Friday do you mean (date), or should I change the recurring series?  
2. What timezone is “my time” (your location, e.g., America/Los_Angeles)?  
3. When you say “move it to 8am,” do you mean 08:00 in London time (Europe/London) or 08:00 in your timezone?  
4. Confirm the exact event to update (is the calendar event title “Partner sync with the London team” and on your calendar?).  
5. Change scope: one occurrence or the whole series?  
6. May I check attendees’ availability and send updated invites/notifications when I reschedule?  
7. Any message you want included in the update to attendees?

Reply with answers and I’ll proceed.
